prompt:
Workflow step: Use the fixed robot arm to pick up the test tube from tray and move it to capping device to screw on the test tube cap.
Inspection timing: after this step
Inspection location: capping device
What the inspection checks: Check near capping device whether the test tube on the gripper has been screwed on.

A description of the inspection camera's photograph follows, written by someone who was not told what is being checked.

Description: Centre of frame: a conical-bottom graduated centrifuge tube (markings visible up to about 45 mL) held upright in a black clamp/holder mounted on a dark carbon-fibre-patterned panel. The tube has an orange screw cap in place and contains a red-pink liquid filling most of its volume. Above it, higher on the same panel, sits a white cylindrical component with a metal bracket and screws, below which is a red-orange block or holder with a dark slot. To the right is black machined equipment with a round dial bearing curved arrow markings, silver bolts, a white plastic block, a green vertical plate, and a grey dome-shaped sensor head on an arm. Left side: white panel and a pale vertical blind.
observations: The centrifuge tube held in the gripper/clamp at the capping device is shown upright with an orange screw cap seated in place, indicating the cap was successfully screwed on.
